I've read the first two links multiple times before, so I guess it didn't help. They also don't mention anything about slicing a tensor with different integer types, AFAIK. The third issue has a similar error but it comes from keras and the solution there is not applicable here.

In any case, I've already worked it around by casting the result from `row_lengths` to int32. It is still weird that if I comment out the `tf.repeat` line, it doesn't throw an error. If slicing with int64 type is supported for `batch_jacobian`, which I guess it is because it works if `tf.repeat` is not involved and it also works when training a model, it should be supported under any circumstances, thus I report it as a bug.
